title: Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Security: A Practical Guide to Data Breach Prevention
description: AI is used in cyber security for threat detection, breach prevention, anomaly spotting, response support, and filtering signal from noise.
short_description: A no-hype guide to threat detection, breach prevention, alert noise, and the security decisions humans still have to own.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Cyber Security for security teams, risk managers, founders, and readers tracking digital defence.
